newsitem.title: USA: Copperweld to invest additional $12.4 million.
newsitem.headline: Copperweld to invest additional $12.4 million.

text.p: Copperweld Corp said Monday it would invest an additional $12.4 million to expand manufacturing capacity in its Fayetteville, Tenn. bi-metallic wire plant.
The added funds mark the fourth major expansion of the facility since 1989 and will bring the total amount invested in the plant over $32 million.
Copperweld said in a statement that it expects to complete expansion in the second half of 1998.
Bi-metallic wire is used for CATV coaxial cable, telephone drop wire and ground wire for electric utilities.
